npcs.name: Thorgunna
npcs.idle: My Alf drowned in the swamp four winters ago. He came to my door last night.

npcs.name: Runemistress Gunnvor
npcs.idle: My brother went into the hagbui barrows for a sword. The hagbui keep what goes in.

npcs.name: Warden-Captain Steinunn
npcs.idle: The Wardens held Hrafnsholm for three hundred years. We lost it in a night. To the dead.

npcs.name: Huscarl Gisli
npcs.idle: The King sent twelve of us. Vanern's had eleven so far.

quests.title: The Clay Child
quests.offer:
My son Alf drowned at the western ford four winters ago. Last night something knocked at my door and called me Mother. It looked like Alf. It was made of mud. Clay. It had his face.

I screamed and slammed the door. It went away crying. Will you [find out what it is]? I can't sleep. I can't stop hearing it cry.
quests.summary: Something made of clay, with her drowned son's face, knocked at Thorgunna's door and called her Mother.

steps.goal: Go to the western ford where Alf drowned
steps.text: Small footprints in the mud. Clay footprints - they dry and crumble as you watch. They lead west.

steps.goal: Cut through the forest vipers on the trail
Follow the trail to the clay jotuns' camp
steps.text: Clay jotuns, huge and slow, shaping figures from the swamp mud. Among the half-made giants, a small clay boy sits alone.

steps.say:
Are you from Mother? Did she send you?

The shaper made me out of the ford-mud. Where the boy fell in. He said the mud remembered the boy, so I do too. I remember Mother's soup. And her hands. I went to see her and she [screamed].

steps.text: The shaper slumps into a heap of wet clay. The little clay boy watches it with wide clay eyes.

stages.name: Leirr the Shaper
stages.announce: A clay jotun with long fingers rises from its work. 'That one is mine. I made it from a drowned thing. It is for the army.'

steps.goal: Bring the clay boy to Thorgunna
steps.say:
It's - he's - it's standing behind you. In the rain. And he's crumbling a little, at the edges.

It isn't Alf. I know that. But it remembers my soup. It remembers my hands.

If I [take him in], he'll fall apart at the next big rain - Ulf the seer says a month, maybe two. I'd have him a month. Or I [send him back] to the swamp, and the mud, and don't have to watch it happen again.

options.say: Come here. Come in. Mind the step. ...There. He's sitting by the fire. He's drying out. He says it's warm.
Go back. Go back to the ford. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I can't. ...He's going. He's not crying. That's worse.

kept.text: Take this. He made it for you, while he could.

sent.text: Take this. I can't look at it.

quests.title: The Unburied Thane
quests.offer:
This is GROUP work. The hagbui are draugr - barrow-dead - and their thane is old and terrible.

My brother Ketil went into the hagbui barrows in the north-west for our grandfather's sword, Leg-Biter, buried with the thane who killed him. Ketil didn't come out. Last week my seeing-stones showed him walking among the hagbui. Dead. Still walking.

Will you [go into the barrows]?
quests.summary: GROUP. Runemistress Gunnvor's brother went into the hagbui barrows for an ancestral sword and now walks among the draugr.

steps.goal: Go to the hagbui barrows in the north-west
steps.text: Barrow-mounds steaming in the cold. The dead walk between them, armed and patient.
Among them, one draugr wears a living man's ring - Gunnvor's family rune. Ketil, or what's left. He watches you and doesn't come closer.

clue.name: a runestone at the barrow mouth

steps.text: 'Here lies Ulfhedinn, who slew Gunnar Leg-Biter's-Bearer and took his sword into the dark. Who takes it out takes his place.' Ketil took it out. That's why he walks.
The thane falls, and the sword Leg-Biter clatters onto the barrow stones. Every hagbui on the mounds stops and turns towards it.

stages.name: Thane Ulfhedinn the Unburied
stages.announce: The barrow opens. Something huge and dead in rotten mail climbs out, an empty scabbard at its hip. 'WHO HOLDS MY SWORD?'

steps.say:
You've seen him. Ketil. And the sword.

The runes say whoever bears Leg-Biter out of the barrow takes the thane's place, so Ketil walks. If I [burn the barrows], the hagbui burn - all of them, Ketil too, his soul with them. They'll never walk again.

Or we [bury him with honour] - sword and all, in the thane's own barrow. He'll be the new thane. The hagbui will walk on. But he'll be Ketil, in a way. I can't. Tell me.

options.say: Then I'll carve the fire-runes myself. Tonight. ... Goodbye, Ketil. You always were the brave one.
Then he'll be thane. Thane of the barrows. Our grandfather would laugh. ...I'll visit him. Once a year. With mead he can't drink.

burned.text: Take something from my grandfather's hoard.

thane.text: Take something from my grandfather's hoard.

quests.title: The Mud Flats
quests.offer:
Welcome to Vanern. The mud crab warriors come up the flats to the camp every night. They're the least of our troubles - start there.

Will you [clear the flats]?
quests.summary: Mud crab warriors come up Vanern's mud flats to the Wardens' camp every night.

steps.goal: Clear the mud crab warriors about 180 m south-east of Warden-Captain Steinunn

steps.say: Good. You'll live long enough to be useful, maybe.

quests.title: The Reed Road
quests.offer:
The forest vipers on the reed road west of camp - every runner we send to the King gets bitten. Clear the road.

Will you [clear the reed road]?
quests.summary: Forest vipers bite every runner on Vanern's reed road.

steps.goal: Clear the forest vipers about 350 m south-west of Warden-Captain Steinunn

steps.say: The road's open. The runner can go to Jordheim. Not that the King has anyone left to send.

quests.title: The Clay Pits
quests.offer:
The clay jotun in the middle of the swamp were always quiet - the swamp's own, made of its mud. Now they're angry, and someone's been digging in their pits.

Will you [look into it]?
quests.summary: The clay jotun in the middle of Vanern Swamp have turned angry; someone has been digging in their pits.

steps.goal: Fight through the clay jotun about 590 m west of Runemistress Gunnvor

clue.name: a broken chain half-buried in the clay

steps.text: Black iron chains, carved with barrow-runes - the hagbui's. They've been digging clay jotun out of the pits, and dragging them north-west in chains.

steps.say: Barrow-runes. The hagbui. They're taking slaves - jotun, to work their forge in Hrafnsholm. The dead don't need forges unless they mean war.

quests.title: The Broken Ones
quests.offer:
The broken jotun in the west - they were the hagbui's slaves before. Worked till they broke, then thrown out. They're mad with it, and they kill anything that moves.

Will you [put them out of their misery]?
quests.accept: put them out of their misery
quests.summary: The broken jotun of Vanern's west, the hagbui's worn-out slaves, kill anything that moves.

steps.goal: Put down the broken jotun about 1.0 km west of Huscarl Gisli

steps.say: Mercy, of a sort. If that's what the hagbui do to their slaves, I'd rather not think about the one in the yard at Hrafnsholm.

quests.title: The Crippled Jotun
quests.offer:
The crippled jotun in the west still wear their chains - and the chains still hold the hagbui's runes. While they wear them, the hagbui can call them back. Break them free, the only way left.

Will you [free them]?
quests.summary: Vanern's crippled jotun still wear the hagbui's runed chains.

steps.goal: Free the crippled jotun about 1.0 km west of Runemistress Gunnvor

steps.say: Free. The runes broke with them - I felt it from here. Now we know how the hagbui hold their slaves. That's how we'll free the one in their yard.

quests.title: The Enslaved Orms
quests.offer:
The jotun outcasts in the north drive enslaved orms - harnessed, whipped, run till they drop. They're hauling something north-west.

Will you [free the orms]?
quests.summary: Jotun outcasts drive enslaved orms north-west across Vanern's north.

steps.goal: Free the large enslaved orm runners about 1.1 km north-west of Huscarl Gisli

steps.say: They were hauling ice. Ice, in summer, out of the north-west - from Raumarik. The outcasts are building something.

quests.title: The Outcasts
quests.offer:
The jotun outcasts themselves. They're building a road of ice to Raumarik. I want to know why. Bring friends - they're jotun.

Will you [break the outcasts]?
quests.summary: Jotun outcasts in Vanern's north are building a road of ice toward Raumarik.

steps.goal: Break the jotun outcasts about 1.0 km north-west of Huscarl Gisli

steps.text: Carved deep in the ice: 'When Hati catches the moon, the long winter comes, and the jotun walk south on the ice behind him. The barrow-dead will open the door.'

steps.say:
The barrow-dead will open the door. The hagbui and the jotun - they're both waiting for Hati and the winter. Hrafnsholm is the door.

Steinunn needs to hear this.

quests.title: Silk for the Runes
quests.offer:
To break the hagbui's runes I need rune-thread - forest spider silk, the strongest in Midgard. The spiders won't give it gladly.

Will you [gather silk]?
quests.summary: Gunnvor needs forest spider silk from Vanern's north-east to break the hagbui's runes.

steps.goal: Gather silk from the forest spiders about 750 m north of Runemistress Gunnvor

steps.say: Good silk. I'll spin rune-thread from it - enough to bind the dead back into their barrows, if it comes to it.

quests.title: The Hagbui Berserkers
quests.offer:
The hagbui berserkers roam the ground below Hrafnsholm - dead men who fight like they want to die again. Every one we break is one less on the walls.

Will you [break the berserkers]?
quests.summary: Hagbui berserkers roam the ground below Hrafnsholm, the Wardens' lost watch-hold.

steps.goal: Break the hagbui berserkers about 1.1 km north-west of Warden-Captain Steinunn

steps.say: Good. Every one tells the Wardens we can take the hold back.

quests.title: The Spiritmasters
quests.offer:
The hagbui spiritmasters raise the dead of the barrows. While they stand, every hagbui we break gets up again.

Will you [break the spiritmasters]?
quests.summary: Hagbui spiritmasters raise the dead of Vanern's barrows.

steps.goal: Break the hagbui spiritmasters about 1.2 km north-west of Runemistress Gunnvor

steps.say: The dead will stay down now. Mostly.

quests.title: The Runemasters
quests.offer:
The hagbui runemasters keep the jotun's chains in Hrafnsholm's yard, and the thanes guard them. Break them, and the dead lose their slave.

Bring friends. Will you [break the runemasters]?
quests.summary: Hagbui runemasters and thanes keep the chained jotun in Hrafnsholm's yard.

steps.goal: Break the hagbui runemasters about 1.3 km north-west of Warden-Captain Steinunn

steps.say: Broken. The chains will be weaker. When we take the hold, Gunnvor can free the jotun - or the hagbui will turn him on us.

quests.title: Hrafnsholm
quests.offer:
Hrafnsholm. Our hold, three hundred years. Go and look at it - count the dead on the walls, find the gate. Then come back and tell me we can take it back.

Will you [scout the hold]?
quests.summary: The Wardens of Vanern mean to take back Hrafnsholm, their watch-hold, from the hagbui.

steps.goal: Climb to the ridge above Hrafnsholm
steps.text: The old watch-hold, its timbers black with frost in summer. Dead men on the walls, unmoving. In the yard, a jotun in chains, hammering at a forge - and the forge-fire is blue and cold.
The Wardens' raven banner, torn and nailed upside down. Under it, carved in ice: 'WE OPEN THE DOOR FOR THE WINTER. HATI COMES.'

steps.say:
They nailed our banner upside down. Then we take it back for every Warden who held it.

The Wardens will march when the swamp is behind us - every berserker, every spiritmaster, every runemaster broken tells them they can win. Be there.
